title: The Call to Justice and the People's Rejection
description: The Lord demands true justice and care for the weak—widows, orphans, foreigners, and the poor—but the people refused to listen, turned a stubborn shoulder, and made their hearts hard as diamond. Because they ignored the law and the words of the former prophets, the Lord's great wrath came: they were scattered among the nations, and the glorious land was laid waste [ref:Sach 7:8-14|Sach 7:8-14].
